title: General RRCReconfiguration (sent via other RAT) RRCReconfigurationComplete

entities.name: Handover to NR
entities.description: Procedure to transfer a connection between UE and another Radio Access Network (e.g. E-UTRAN) to NR under network control. Applies when SRBs, possibly with DRBs, are established in another RAT.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE via other RAT to initiate handover to NR.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationComplete
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to confirm successful RRC reconfiguration.

entities.name: Integrity activated in E-UTRA
entities.description: Condition that handover from E-UTRA to NR applies only after integrity has been activated in E-UTRA.

entities.name: SRBs and DRBs established in other RAT
entities.description: Condition that handover to NR procedure applies when SRBs, possibly in combination with DRBs, are established in another RAT.

relations.description: Handover procedure includes sending RRCReconfiguration message
Handover procedure includes receiving RRCReconfigurationComplete message
Handover procedure requires integrity to be activated in E-UTRA
Handover procedure requires SRBs and DRBs to be established in another RAT
